summary: Round 1 UI refresh verified end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest checks pass against the public URL (health, root, pass lookup incl. FF-8492/FF-TEST-001, register + duplicate + validation, admin login (good/bad), scan auth 401 + valid/already_used/404, stats consistency). Frontend: every requested data-testid assertion passed — brand-tag (B.COM ASSOCIATION x GOKUL CAMPUS), exact hero-tagline, FRESHERS '26 headline, hero-side-note COUNTDOWN + FRESHERS '26 badge (no FREQUENCY/2026), countdown-panel label 'COUNTDOWN · FRESHERS 26' + 'THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER' with seconds ticking and day/hour/minute values matching the 2026-09-01T09:00 target, nav label REGISTER -> 'REGISTER FOR FRESHERS 26' page, lineup day1 3 rows / day2 5 rows expand+collapse with chevron rotation, agenda CTA 'REGISTER NOW', digital ticket for FF-8492 with attendee/roll/all 4 meta rows/foil strip/QR, copy toast, dismiss -> pass-hidden-state with ZERO network calls (sessionStorage frenzy-pass-hidden=1) persisting across nav and restore returning identical data, empty-pass-state REGISTER NOW navigation, admin login modal -> admin-hero with stats 4/1/3 from /api/stats, all 3 expandable sections toggling, logout locking the portal, manual scan of FF-8492 returning 'Valid entry', guest scanner locked, and no console errors. Real defects found: registration failures are silently swallowed into a fake local pass, and the mobile (375px) hero overflows/overlaps.

minor.issue: Returns 403 for wrong credentials; 401 is the conventional code for failed authentication
All registrations live in an in-memory dict in server.py (no MongoDB). Every backend restart/hot-reload wipes real registrations while the admin panel still reports 'Database: PERSISTED'

ui_bugs.issue: Hero content overflows the viewport and is clipped: .hero-copy measures 384px wide with right edge at 404px vs 375px viewport (app-shell overflow:hidden hides it). Result: headline reads 'FRESHER', tagline is cut at 'New Jour', eyebrow cut at 'KLE TECH · H'. Root cause: unbreakable 'FRESHERS' word at clamp(56px,10vw,150px) sets a min-content width larger than the padded container.

Absolutely positioned [data-testid="hero-side-note"] (x166-355, y610-706) sits on top of the full-width GET YOUR PASS button (x20-404, y611-660), making the button label unreadable. Click still registers, so it is visual obstruction, not dead control.
Dismiss control overlaps the ticket top label — dismiss-pass-button box (x672-708) intersects '.ticket-top > span' (x689-967), hiding the first characters of 'B.COM ASSOCIATION · GOKUL CAMPUS'.

integration_issues.issue: Duplicate/invalid registration is silently treated as success. Backend correctly returns 400 ('This roll number is already registered'), but Register()'s catch block fabricates a local pass (random FF-xxxx) whenever name/roll/email/gender are filled and navigates to the ticket. Verified: re-submitting an existing roll produced no [data-testid="registration-error"] and rendered an entry-pass-card that does not exist on the backend. Also the error path reads data.error while FastAPI returns data.detail, so genuine messages would never surface.

AdminModal falls back to a fake token 'local-demo-admin' whenever /api/admin/login errors, granting client-side admin UI without a server session; subsequent /api/scan calls would 401 and only show the raw detail string.

A pass found via lookup is kept only in React state (localStorage is written on registration only), so a full browser reload drops it and shows empty-pass-state. Nav-level persistence of the hidden flag works as specified.

action_items: Register(): stop fabricating a local pass on API failure — surface data.detail (FastAPI) in [data-testid="registration-error"] and keep the user on the form for 400/422 responses
AdminModal(): remove the 'local-demo-admin' fallback so admin state always reflects a real server token

Fix mobile hero: allow the FRESHERS headline to shrink/wrap (word-break/overflow-wrap or smaller clamp min) so hero-copy fits within the 375px viewport, and reposition/hide .hero-side-note below the hero actions so it stops covering GET YOUR PASS
Offset the ticket dismiss button (or pad .ticket-top) so it no longer covers the association label; raise contrast of ticket-top mono text
Consider persisting registrations in MongoDB (currently in-memory dict; data lost on restart) or update the admin 'Database: PERSISTED' claim
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js Register(): the try/catch fallback masks all backend validation errors and issues client-side pass IDs that gate staff cannot verify — highest-priority fix
/app/frontend/src/App.js reads `data.error` for API errors, but the backend always returns `detail`; every error message path is dead code
/app/backend/server.py stores registrations/sessions in module-level dicts — no persistence, no multi-worker safety
/app/frontend/src/App.css is a single ~90-column-wide minified line and App.js packs whole components onto single lines; both are effectively unreviewable and should be split/formatted
Dead code: tab 'gate' navigates to /gate-display but no view renders for it, and the router defines no <Routes>

Note FF-8492 may already be status=scanned.
rca_of_the_issue: Silent-success registration: Register()'s catch block builds `local = {...form, qr_code_id: FF-random}` and calls onDone whenever the four required fields are non-empty, so a legitimate 400 from POST /api/register (duplicate roll) is converted into a locally minted ticket; additionally `data.error` never exists on FastAPI error bodies (`detail`), so the intended error message is unreachable. Mobile hero clipping: .home-view padding leaves ~335px usable, but .hero-copy's min-content width (driven by the single unbreakable 'FRESHERS' word at 56px) is 384px, overflowing the 375px viewport where .app-shell{overflow:hidden} clips the text; .hero-side-note is position:absolute right/bottom:12% and lands on top of the mobile full-width .hero-actions button.
